params.body:
## What

`deploy/gcp/startup.sh` pins v0.28.1 and its sha256, the release that carries #87: the GitHub adapter names `issue.open` among the kinds it answers, so the registry routes it instead of answering "no effect adapter for this kind", and a test refuses any future case in the switch that nothing claims.

## After the merge

`export CONTROL_GCP_PROJECT=elixir-508105 && cd ~/Projects/control && deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade`
